panels.spec/description:
Redirects per executed strongly consistent request in the whole cluster. The dc, rack, node and shard selections do not apply, because a redirect is counted on the node that redirects a request and the request on the node that executes it. A driver that routes requests to the leader keeps the ratio near zero. With a token-aware driver that is not leader aware and three replicas, about two in three writes and linearizable reads are redirected to another node.

panels.spec/description:
Tablet Raft groups led by a node, summed over the strongly consistent tables. Only the leader of a group executes writes and linearizable reads, so a node that leads more groups than its peers gets more of the load. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_leaders

Raft log entries applied to the replicas per second. Every replica applies every committed entry, so a node that applies fewer than its peers falls behind. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_applied_entries

Entries in the Raft logs of the strongly consistent tables that are not committed yet. A growing value means the entries are not replicated to a majority as fast as they are added. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_uncommitted_entries

Committed Raft log entries that a node has not applied to its replica yet. A growing value means the node falls behind applying writes. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_unapplied_entries

read_quorum messages the leaders send to their followers to confirm they still lead before serving a linearizable read. One round sends a message to each follower, and several reads can share a round. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_messages_sent

panels.spec/title: Read barrier messages per linearizable read by [[by]]
panels.spec/description:
read_quorum messages sent per linearizable read, on the node that leads the groups and executes the reads. A read that needs a round of its own sends one message to each follower, 2 with three replicas, and reads that share a round send fewer. A round that does not reach a majority by the next tick is sent again, which raises the value. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

Raft logs that have no room under max_follower_log_size for the next entry from the leader. The follower refuses entries until its log shrinks, and the leader stops sending to it. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_full_logs

Followers that the leaders cannot send entries to, by reason. probe: waiting for the reply to a probe of the follower's log. pipeline_full: the maximal number of append requests is in flight. snapshot: waiting for a snapshot transfer. log_full: the follower reported a full log. Followers the failure detector reports down are not counted. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_blocked_followers

panels.spec/title: Entries waiting for log space by [[by]]
panels.spec/description:
Entries waiting for an in-memory Raft log to shrink below max_log_size before they can be appended. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_log_limiter_waiters

Times appending an entry had to wait for the in-memory Raft log to shrink below max_log_size. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_log_limiter_waits
panels.spec/data/spec/queries/0/spec/query/spec: $topbottom([[filter_limit]], sum(rate(scylla_strong_consistency_raft_log_limiter_waits{instance=~"[[node]]",cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", rack=~"$rack", shard=~"[[shard]]|$^"}[$__rate_interval])) by ([[by]]) or on([[by]]) sum(scylla_strong_consistency_raft_leaders{instance=~"[[node]]",cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", rack=~"$rack", shard=~"[[shard]]|$^"}) by ([[by]]) * 0)

panels.spec/description:
Memory used by the in-memory part of the Raft logs of the strongly consistent tables. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_log_memory_usage

Bytes of Raft append requests being sent, as charged against the in-flight memory limit. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_append_entries_in_flight_bytes

panels.spec/title: Append requests waiting for memory by [[by]]
panels.spec/description:
Raft append requests waiting for the memory of other in-flight append requests to be released. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_append_entries_memory_waiters

Raft append requests that had to wait for the memory of other in-flight append requests to be released. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_raft_append_entries_memory_waits
panels.spec/data/spec/queries/0/spec/query/spec: $topbottom([[filter_limit]], sum(rate(scylla_strong_consistency_raft_append_entries_memory_waits{instance=~"[[node]]",cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", rack=~"$rack", shard=~"[[shard]]|$^"}[$__rate_interval])) by ([[by]]) or on([[by]]) sum(scylla_strong_consistency_raft_leaders{instance=~"[[node]]",cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", rack=~"$rack", shard=~"[[shard]]|$^"}) by ([[by]]) * 0)

panels.spec/description:
Average time a node takes to apply a write from a Raft log to its replica, including resolving the schema the write was made with. Every replica applies every write. It divides the total time by the number of requests, so unlike the percentiles it is not limited by the latency buckets. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_state_machine_apply_latency
panels.spec/data/spec/queries/0/spec/query/spec: $topbottom([[filter_limit]], sum(rate(scylla_strong_consistency_state_machine_apply_latency_sum{instance=~"[[node]]",cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", rack=~"$rack", shard=~"[[shard]]|$^"}[$__rate_interval])) by ([[by]]) / (sum(rate(scylla_strong_consistency_state_machine_apply_latency_count{instance=~"[[node]]",cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", rack=~"$rack", shard=~"[[shard]]|$^"}[$__rate_interval])) by ([[by]]) > 0) or sum(histogram_sum(rate(scylla_strong_consistency_state_machine_apply_latency{instance=~"[[node]]",cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", rack=~"$rack", shard=~"[[shard]]|$^"}[$__rate_interval]))) by ([[by]]) / (sum(histogram_count(rate(scylla_strong_consistency_state_machine_apply_latency{instance=~"[[node]]",cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", rack=~"$rack", shard=~"[[shard]]|$^"}[$__rate_interval]))) by ([[by]]) > 0))

panels.spec/description:
99th percentile of the time a node takes to apply a write from a Raft log to its replica. ScyllaDB sorts latencies into buckets, and the smallest bucket holds everything up to 640 µs, so any latency below 640 µs shows as a value up to 640 µs. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_state_machine_apply_latency
panels.spec/data/spec/queries/0/spec/query/spec: $topbottom([[filter_limit]], histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(scylla_strong_consistency_state_machine_apply_latency_bucket{instance=~"[[node]]",cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", rack=~"$rack", shard=~"[[shard]]|$^"}[$__rate_interval])) by ([[by]], le)) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(scylla_strong_consistency_state_machine_apply_latency{instance=~"[[node]]",cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", rack=~"$rack", shard=~"[[shard]]|$^"}[$__rate_interval])) by ([[by]])))

panels.spec/description:
Times applying Raft log entries waited for a group 0 read barrier, because an entry was written with a schema the node did not know yet. The wait holds up every later entry of the tablet's Raft group on that node. Values are per node unless per shard table metrics are enabled (enable_keyspace_column_family_metrics).

scylla_strong_consistency_state_machine_schema_barrier_waits
panels.spec/data/spec/queries/0/spec/query/spec: $topbottom([[filter_limit]], sum(rate(scylla_strong_consistency_state_machine_schema_barrier_waits{instance=~"[[node]]",cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", rack=~"$rack", shard=~"[[shard]]|$^"}[$__rate_interval])) by ([[by]]) or on([[by]]) sum(scylla_strong_consistency_raft_leaders{instance=~"[[node]]",cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", rack=~"$rack", shard=~"[[shard]]|$^"}) by ([[by]]) * 0)

panels.spec/description:
The percentage of the time during which Scylla utilized the CPU. Strongly consistent requests are executed by the leader of each tablet's Raft group, so compare the load with the leaders and the requests per node or shard.

scylla_reactor_utilization

Time the selected shards spent in each scheduling group, where 100% is the whole time of one shard. Choose Maximum to see the most time any one shard spent in each group. Strongly consistent requests run in the scheduling group of their service level, while the Raft messages of their tablet groups are handled in the gossip group, so a shard busy with these tables can spend much of its time in gossip.

scylla_scheduler_runtime_ms
